## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle late-Míng *novice-precept manual* by **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** ([智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD), 1599–1655), explicitly described as a *chóngjí* 重輯 ("recompilation") drawn directly from canonical *vinaya* sources. Author signature: *Gǔwú Ǒuyì shāmén Zhìxù yī lǜ chóng jí* 古吳蕅益沙門　智旭　依律重輯 ("Zhìxù, monk of Old Wú at *Ǒuyì* [Hermitage] recompiled this from the *vinaya*").

**Abstract**

The *Shāmí shíjiè wēiyí lùyào* is the principal **late-Míng Tiāntái-school recension** of the *Shāmí lǜyí* genre. Where Zhūhóng's parent text *Shāmí lǜyí yàolüè* dominated the Bǎohuáshān–Zhāoqìng tradition (commented in [KR6k0228](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0228)), and Hóngzàn's *Zēngzhù* dominated the Dǐnghú line (commented in [KR6k0232](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0232)), Zhìxù's *Lùyào* anchored the *Tiāntái-Língfēng* line — completing the three-way distribution of post-Yúnqī novice manuals in the Míng-Qīng. Composition is bracketed by Zhìxù's mature commentary period (from the early 1620s, when he settled at *Língfēngshān* 靈峰山) and his death in 1655; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are 1620–1655.
